    // The zero level set of a sampled SDF, whose values sit on lattice NODES
    // spanning its Bounds inclusively, so the extracted surface spans the whole
    // of Bounds.
    MarchingCubes(self: SampledSdf3D): TriangleArray3D
        => MarchingCubesLattice(
            IntegerVector3(self.Values.ColumnCount, self.Values.RowCount, self.Values.LayerCount),
            (i, j, k) => self.Values.At(i, j, k).Negative,
            (i, j, k) => self.NodePosition(i, j, k),
            0.0);

    // The isosurface at isoLevel of any spatial scalar field, sampled on a
    // lattice of nodeCounts nodes spanning bounds inclusively. Nothing is stored:
    // the field is evaluated once per node visit, which costs eight evaluations
    // per cube and needs no grid.
    MarchingCubes(self: IScalarField3D, bounds: Bounds3D, nodeCounts: IntegerVector3, isoLevel: Number): TriangleArray3D
        => MarchingCubesLattice(
            nodeCounts,
            (i, j, k) => self.Eval(LatticeNodePosition(bounds, nodeCounts, i, j, k)),
            (i, j, k) => LatticeNodePosition(bounds, nodeCounts, i, j, k),
            isoLevel);

    // The zero level set of a signed distance field, sampled on a lattice of
    // nodeCounts nodes spanning bounds. Negated against the shared convention,
    // because an SDF is negative inside.
    MarchingCubes(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, bounds: Bounds3D, nodeCounts: IntegerVector3): TriangleArray3D
        => MarchingCubesLattice(
            nodeCounts,
            (i, j, k) => self.Eval(LatticeNodePosition(bounds, nodeCounts, i, j, k)).Negative,
            (i, j, k) => LatticeNodePosition(bounds, nodeCounts, i, j, k),
            0.0);

    // The world position of lattice node (i, j, k) of a lattice of nodeCounts
    // nodes spanning bounds inclusively.
    LatticeNodePosition(bounds: Bounds3D, nodeCounts: IntegerVector3, i: Integer, j: Integer, k: Integer): Point3D
        => Point3D(
            LatticeNodeCoordinate(bounds.Min.X, bounds.Max.X, i, nodeCounts.X),
            LatticeNodeCoordinate(bounds.Min.Y, bounds.Max.Y, j, nodeCounts.Y),
            LatticeNodeCoordinate(bounds.Min.Z, bounds.Max.Z, k, nodeCounts.Z));
}
